title: Foundations
blurb: The ground every tool stands on: the shell, Git, networks and the cloud, and Python for scripts.

title: Build and ship
blurb: Package the app as an image, test and publish it on every push, and build JVM code fast.

title: Infrastructure as code
blurb: Create servers and networks from files, then set them up the same way every time.

title: Run on Kubernetes
blurb: Run many containers across many machines, and deploy by merging to Git.

title: Observability
blurb: Metrics, dashboards, logs and traces, so you know how the system behaves.

title: Operate at scale
blurb: Tools for many services: a mesh for the calls between them, and one platform for every signal.

title: Security, AI and the capstone
blurb: Guard the supply chain, use AI safely, build a platform, then ship the whole thing.
